title: Terrain and building-height source audit for Ankara/Turkiye

method.reason: The phase selects an ingestion contract before acquiring regional rasters or vendor tiles.
method.coordinate_contract: EPSG:4326 for the current dataset pack and GeoTIFF sampler
method.license_policy: Record source terms and checksums; do not commit restricted raw source files.

current_sources.resolution: Vector footprint resolution varies by mapping; no uniform height accuracy
current_sources.coverage: 161784 loader-visible footprints; 1108 explicit height tags and 4966 levels-derived records
current_sources.vertical_datum: AGL semantics for height tags; absolute terrain datum unavailable
current_sources.license: ODbL 1.0 for OSM database data; preserve attribution and source terms
current_sources.download_or_api: Current repository data-pipeline pack; future refresh through an OSM extract/provider
current_sources.expected_accuracy: Not calibrated in this pack; explicit tag is trusted relative evidence, levels are qualified derivation
current_sources.ankara_applicability: Active baseline source; sparse height coverage
current_sources.decision: retain and expose as provenance-aware evidence

terrain_candidates.coverage: Global, including Turkiye/Ankara; tile acquisition was not performed
terrain_candidates.vertical_datum: WGS84 horizontal; EGM2008 vertical reference in the product handbook
terrain_candidates.data_type: DSM / surface model, not bare-earth DTM
terrain_candidates.license: Copernicus Data Space access and product terms must be retained with any acquisition
terrain_candidates.download_or_api: Copernicus Data Space / Sentinel Hub DEM APIs; provider access required
terrain_candidates.expected_accuracy: Use the product handbook quality layers and local validation; no Ankara accuracy claim is made here
terrain_candidates.ankara_applicability: Useful surface diagnostic candidate; not ground elevation without an explicit DTM/vegetation derivation
terrain_candidates.decision: do not activate as terrain; eligible for diagnostic DSM experiments

terrain_candidates.resolution: Approximately 30 m; HGT and raster distributions vary by product
terrain_candidates.coverage: Global land coverage in Ankara latitude range
terrain_candidates.vertical_datum: NASADEM void-filled HGT values are documented relative to the EGM96 geoid; SRTM-only float values use the WGS84 ellipsoid
terrain_candidates.data_type: DEM with surface/void-fill semantics requiring local ground validation; not treated as authoritative DTM here
terrain_candidates.license: NASA/USGS distribution terms; retain product attribution and metadata
terrain_candidates.download_or_api: Earthdata/LP DAAC or documented distribution; credentials may be required
terrain_candidates.expected_accuracy: NASADEM guide reports generally sub-8 m performance in sparsely vegetated validation conditions; local urban/vegetation error remains unvalidated
terrain_candidates.ankara_applicability: Potential terrain candidate after datum/ground validation; not acquired
terrain_candidates.decision: dem_unspecified until a source-specific DTM contract and Ankara QA exist

terrain_candidates.vertical_datum: WGS84 horizontal with EGM96 geoid reference in the user guide
terrain_candidates.data_type: DEM / surface-affected elevation; not promoted to DTM
terrain_candidates.expected_accuracy: Use provider quality/void metadata and local validation; no project accuracy claim
terrain_candidates.ankara_applicability: Fallback candidate only; Copernicus/NASA alternatives should be compared before selection

terrain_candidates.resolution: Depends on selected SRTM, NASADEM, Copernicus DSM, or other product
terrain_candidates.coverage: API lists global products covering Ankara; exact product tile not selected
terrain_candidates.vertical_datum: Inherited from the selected product; never inferred from the API wrapper
terrain_candidates.data_type: Distribution service, not a new DTM
terrain_candidates.license: Inherited per dataset; API keys/rate limits apply
terrain_candidates.download_or_api: OpenTopography Global DEM API; credentials must not be hard-coded
terrain_candidates.ankara_applicability: Convenient acquisition route after product selection

terrain_candidates.provider: Republic of Turkiye Ministry of Environment, Urbanization and Climate Change / National Geospatial sources
terrain_candidates.dataset: True ortho, 3D point cloud/building inventory, and DSM/DTM-related national products
terrain_candidates.resolution: Official project pages describe 5–10 cm point-cloud and 10 cm orthophoto/3D products for covered areas; exact Ankara product selection is not public in this repo
terrain_candidates.coverage: Large project areas and authorized services; national/Ankara coverage and current tile access require account/order or institutional authorization
terrain_candidates.vertical_datum: Official project material describes ITRF96 3-degree horizontal systems and orthometric height workflows; exact product metadata must accompany each tile
terrain_candidates.license: Access-controlled/commercial or institutional terms; not redistributable by default
terrain_candidates.download_or_api: National geospatial services/data portal; e-Devlet/account/order/payment or institutional service access
terrain_candidates.expected_accuracy: Potentially highest local value, but product-specific QA and licensing are unresolved
terrain_candidates.update_date: Official project and portal pages consulted 2026-09-19
terrain_candidates.ankara_applicability: Promising authorized source; not suitable for repository activation until access and redistribution are cleared
terrain_candidates.decision: stop-condition for raw acquisition; retain acquisition instructions/metadata only

terrain_candidates.resolution: Unknown; no legally redistributable, Ankara-specific open source confirmed in this audit
terrain_candidates.decision: do not invent coverage or activate

building_height_candidates.resolution: Footprint/vector geometry with model-estimated mean height within a polygon; not a surveyed roof surface
building_height_candidates.coverage: Current public link table includes Turkey quadkeys; exact Ankara tile download and match were not performed
building_height_candidates.vertical_datum: Height is above ground; absolute roof datum is not supplied
building_height_candidates.download_or_api: Country/quadkey link table and blob downloads; acquisition must retain link-table version and file hashes
building_height_candidates.expected_accuracy: Model estimate; project confidence field describes footprint confidence, not height accuracy
building_height_candidates.ankara_applicability: Promising qualified candidate with Turkey coverage; no measured improvement claimed before exact tile matching and disagreement audit

building_height_candidates.coverage: Current pack: 1108 explicit and 4966 levels-derived records
building_height_candidates.vertical_datum: AGL for building height; no terrain base
building_height_candidates.data_type: explicit AGL height plus levels-derived AGL estimate
building_height_candidates.expected_accuracy: Explicit tags retain source claims; 3 m/level conversion is a planning assumption
building_height_candidates.decision: retain with trusted/qualified classes, never collapse to one unqualified float

selection_result.reason: No candidate was legally and operationally ready to improve Ankara coverage in this phase without a source-specific tile acquisition, vertical/height QA, matching audit, and license record.
selection_result.honest_outcome: The architecture is ready; Ankara coverage remains unchanged at 0% terrain and 3.75% observed-or-levels height evidence.
